headline: Altria Group (MO): A Winner in President Trump’s Stock Portfolio?
summary: Altria Group (NYSE:MO) sells cigarettes, oral nicotine pouches, and vapor products to adult tobacco users in the US. It’s the parent of Marlboro, still the country’s top-selling cigarette brand. The stock showed up in Donald Trump’s disclosed portfolio, and it’s easy to see the appeal: over 50 straight years of dividend increases and a business […]

headline: Should You Buy Altria for Its 5.8% Dividend Yield Ahead of July 30 Earnings?
summary: Altria stock has surged over 30% this year and still hands investors a yield that dwarfs most of its large-cap peers, but the July 30 earnings report introduces a variable that could push income investors to act now or regret waiting.
